# Tuya smart sockets (`tuya`)

Switches Tuya-based smart sockets, and USB ports that switch on their own, with the local protocol 3.3 on your network. Setup can look the local keys up in your Tuya cloud project once; the sockets are never switched through the cloud.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/tuya`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/tuya/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/tuya/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | local network |
| Classes | `plug` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | no |
| Guided setup | yes |

## What it reaches

- TCP to the device, port 6668
- HTTPS to `openapi.tuyaeu.com`
- HTTPS to `openapi-weaz.tuyaeu.com`
- HTTPS to `openapi.tuyaus.com`
- HTTPS to `openapi-ueaz.tuyaus.com`
- HTTPS to `openapi.tuyacn.com`
- HTTPS to `openapi.tuyain.com`

Nothing at all while the hub is in dry-run.

## Settings

| Key | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plugs` | Sockets | a list of rows | yes |  | One row per socket, 1 to 32. Each one's local key is stored as a secret, never here. |
| `plugs[].id` | Device id | text, at most 32 | yes |  | The Tuya device id, 10 to 32 lower-case letters and digits. |
| `plugs[].address` | Address | IP address or host name | yes |  | The socket's IPv4 address on the local network. |
| `plugs[].port` | Port | port | no | `6668` | The local protocol's port. |
| `plugs[].name` | Name | text, at most 64 | no |  | How it is shown. Without one it is "Socket 1", "Socket 2" and so on, in this order. |
| `plugs[].usb_dp` | USB data point | whole number, 2 to 255 | no |  | The data point of a USB port that switches on its own, usually 7. It becomes a switch of its own. |

## Secrets

| Slot | Label | Required | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `local_key/{id}` | Local key | yes | The socket's local key: 16 characters as Tuya shows them, stored in base64. |

## Custom actions

None: it offers the standard actions of its classes.
